definitions.association: each predicted frame -> nearest GT stamp within 0.01 s (one pair per frame)
definitions.ate: Sim(3) Umeyama (with scale) of predicted camera centres onto GT, RMSE in metres; ate_over_gt_path = ATE / (sum of consecutive GT distances inside the submap / frame set)
definitions.rel_rot_err_deg: angle between predicted and GT relative rotation R_i^T R_i+1 of consecutive frames, mean over pairs
definitions.rel_dir_err_deg: angle between predicted and GT unit translation direction R_i^T (C_i+1 - C_i) in camera i, mean over pairs
definitions.fx: fx of the decoded 3x3 intrinsics in pixels of the preprocessed image; frac = fx / image width (TUM fr1 calibration: 517.3/640 = 0.808); std is the population std over the frames of the submap
definitions.e2e: end-to-end relative pose first -> last associated frame of the set vs GT: rotation angle error (deg) and translation-direction error (deg, in the first camera frame); the quantity a one-frame-overlap chain hands from submap k to k+1 (a heading error theta displaces what follows by about theta * path length)
definitions.full_submap: submaps with 17 frames (16 new + overlap); shorter last submaps are listed but not in the summaries
definitions.C(i): fx_rel_diff = |fx_k - fx_k+1| / mean of the two, fx of the overlap frame f in submap k (last) and k+1 (first)
definitions.C(ii): depth_rel_diff_median = median over pixels (conf_k > p25_k and conf_k+1 > p25_k+1) of |D_k*c_k - D_k+1*c_k+1| / mean(D_k*c_k, D_k+1*c_k+1); c = Sim(3) scale of the per-submap fit (A); p25 = 25th percentile of the whole submap's depth_conf (+1e-6) as Submap.add_all_points
definitions.C(iii): scale_ratio_literal = (median D_k(f) / median D_k+1(f)) / (T_k / T_k+1), same pixel set as (ii), T = mean distance between consecutive predicted camera centres of the submap (own units); GT free. For a perfectly consistent pair it equals G_k+1 / G_k (ratio of true mean step lengths), so scale_ratio_gt_step_corrected = literal * G_k / G_k+1 is also given (1 = consistent); abs_log = |ln ratio|
definitions.C(iv): s_up = estimate_scale_pairwise exactly as Solver.add_edge (P_temp = inv(K4_k) K4_k+1, median of point-norm ratios on the good mask incl. its fallbacks); s_true = c_k+1 / c_k; s_up_err = s_up / s_true - 1; s_depth_err uses the ratio of median depths instead of s_up
definitions.junction_aggregate: only junctions whose two submaps both have a Sim(3) scale (>= 3 non-collinear frames)
